// game events
sprites.onOverlap(SpriteKind.Player, SpriteKind.Card, function (sprite: Sprite, otherSprite: Sprite) {
    if (flippedCards.length < 2) {
        otherSprite.setKind(SpriteKind.Player)
        let arrayIndex = cardArray.indexOf(otherSprite)
        flippedCards.push(arrayIndex)
        cardArray[arrayIndex].z = 3 
    } if (flippedCards.length == 2 && !checkingMatch) {
        checkingMatch = true
        let firstCard = cardArray[flippedCards[0]]
        let secondCard = cardArray[flippedCards[1]]
        pause(1000)
        if (firstCard.image == secondCard.image) {
            game.splash("You found a match!")
            firstCard.setKind(SpriteKind.Match)
            secondCard.setKind(SpriteKind.Match)
        } else {
            game.splash("Not a match, try again!")
            firstCard.setKind(SpriteKind.Card)
            secondCard.setKind(SpriteKind.Card)
        }

        checkingMatch = false
